description: In IDLE(CONNECTED) the peer's first DATA-ONLY carries TX WIN LWE on FSN 5: Test 2 alone fails, so the D_PDU is not used, this node runs a FULL RESET as initiator and stays in IDLE(CONNECTED); a later ACK-ONLY therefore draws WARNING reason 3.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked (Called node); nothing has flowed, so the node is in IDLE(CONNECTED) (C-0657). At 61000 the peer sends a DATA-ONLY (type 9), FSN 5, C_PDU START and END, TX WIN LWE set and TX WIN UWE clear, with 'boot', 2 blocks, EOT 20, predicted end 71000. Test 1 is not applied, since TX WIN UWE is clear (C-0794). Test 3 (C-0798): at the initial edges RX LWE 0 and RX UWE 65535 the arc runs from 32768 forward to 32767, the whole circle, so FSN 5 passes. Test 2 (C-0797): TX LWE 5 must lie on the arc from RX UWE - 32767 = 32768 forward to RX LWE 0, and it does not. So Test 2 fails alone (C-0802). Nothing in the D_PDU is used (C-1170): no delivery (cas.first_data keeps running), no acknowledgement, and no state change, so the node stays in IDLE(CONNECTED) rather than taking the DATA-ONLY row's move to DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0658, C-1230). The FULL RESET CMD (FULL RESET CMD 1, RESET FRAME ID 0, NEW RECEIVE LWE 0, C-0804 to C-0810, C-1173) goes at 83000 (contention 12000 after the predicted end); dts.reset_wait/0.0.1.3 runs from 88550 for dts.ack_wait_ms (C-1172). The peer's FULL RESET ACK at 96000 ends the exchange and the edges go back to the initial values (C-0821, C-0822, C-0824); a RESET/WIN-RESYNC leaves IDLE(CONNECTED) as it is (C-0661). Nothing is queued, so the burst end at 97000 starts nothing. At 106000 the peer sends an ACK-ONLY, RX LWE 0, no bitmap. In IDLE(CONNECTED) it acknowledges nothing of ours: the node goes to DATA(CONNECTED) and sends WARNING reason 3 naming type 10, telling the CAS with D_WARNING_TRANSMITTED (C-0659, C-0733), and the D_PDU is not tested (C-1180). Had the failed DATA-ONLY moved the node to DATA(CONNECTED), this ACK-ONLY would have passed Test 4 (RX LWE 0 on the arc from TX LWE 0 to TX UWE + 1 = 0, C-0800) and been processed with no output. The WARNING (12 bytes, EOT 10) goes at 156000 (csma.vdcd_end to 111000, contention 45000), followed by a PADDING (11 bytes) in the rest of the block. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap, a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes, an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a WARNING 12 and a PADDING 11. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU when one fits (C-0367, C-1154). The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
